outputs.explanation: Panel A is a western blot image, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B shows phase-contrast micrographs of colonies, not a quantitative plot.

The top flow cytometry pseudocolor plots are raw single-cell data (not a summary plot requiring points). The bottom bar chart summarizing % of cells (mean ± SEM, n=3) displays individual data points as distinct shaped markers for each replicate over each bar.
The top flow cytometry pseudocolor plots are raw single-cell data, exempt from this check. The bottom bar chart (mean ± SD, n=3) shows individual replicate data points overlaid on each bar.
Panel E is a heatmap of normalized (Z-score) expression values; heatmaps are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel F is a western blot image, not a plot of averaged data.
Both bar charts (mean ± SEM, n=3) for pluripotency and lineage marker gene mRNA levels show individual data points (triangle/square/circle markers) overlaid on the bars.
Panel H shows immunofluorescence micrographs, not a quantitative averaged plot.
